frozen_design.module: RUN/control/parent_release_v1.py; stdlib only (hashlib, json, math, os, stat, time, datetime); import = constants/functions only. Entry decide_and_commit(spec, read_bytes, census, owned_date, commit_dir, deadline_check)->dict. Helper build_late_baseline(roots, deadline_check)->dict produces the part-5 baseline with the identical walker; it writes nothing.
frozen_design.spec_exact_keys: item, go, allocation, gate, launch, exit, captures, publication, artifacts, oracle, identities, late_audit, reservation (contract) + exit_table (contract: 'explicit exit table supplied in spec, no defaults'). Extra/missing keys fire P1_SPEC_INVALID plus the owning part's field cause.

spec_field_schemas.go: {path,sha256}; document JSON object with status=='PARENT_GO', item==spec.item, argv list[str] nonempty, pins dict[str,hex64], reservation {bytes,cpu_slots}, gate=={spec.gate}, exit_table==spec.exit_table, and NO key oracle_for
spec_field_schemas.allocation: {registry_path, line_sha256, record}; registry read via read_bytes (16 MiB cap), LF-terminated, every line a JSON object; exactly one line whose sha256 (bytes excluding LF) == line_sha256; parsed line typed-equal to record; record.state=='RUNNING', item==spec.item, reservation_bytes==spec.reservation.bytes, driver_pid/driver_pgid positive ints, go_sha256==spec.go.sha256, launch_record_sha256==spec.launch.sha256, abs_end nonempty str. Current = every later line with the same item is a PRT HELD line (format parent-release-registry-v1, state HELD, allocation_line_sha256 equal).
spec_field_schemas.gate: {path,sha256}; stability_gate_v2 receipt verdict=='PASS', reasons==[], now_date strict /bin/date '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z' text; observed before launch = GO cites the gate digest (hash chain) AND now_date <= launch.started_at
spec_field_schemas.launch: {path,sha256}; document with item, argv, cwd (normalized abs), env_sha256 hex64, pins, reservation, started_at (date text), driver {pid,pgid,start_fingerprint}, go=={spec.go}; item/argv/pins/reservation typed-equal to GO; driver pid/pgid == allocation record; driver fingerprint == the unique role 'driver' identity
spec_field_schemas.exit: {actual_exit:int, observed_by:'parent', wait_record:{path,sha256}}; wait record exact keys {format:'parent-release-wait-v1', item, role:'driver', pid, pgid, start_fingerprint, raw_status:int, actual_exit:int, observed_by:'parent'}; os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(raw_status)==actual_exit==spec value; pid/pgid/fingerprint == driver identity
spec_field_schemas.captures: {stdout,stderr} each exact {path,sha256,bytes_seen,bytes_stored,eof:true,overflow:false,error:null}, bytes_seen==bytes_stored; read_bytes(path, bytes_stored) length and sha equal
spec_field_schemas.publication: {path,sha256,expected_state:str}; bytes read and sha equal; exit_table maps actual_exit to exactly expected_state (missing row => HELD); content interpretation belongs to the separate raw adapter
spec_field_schemas.exit_table: list of exact {actual_exit:int, state:str}, unique actual_exit, must equal GO exit_table
spec_field_schemas.artifacts: {job_dir, declared:{name:{sha256,bytes}}}; module's own anchored NOFOLLOW scandir of job_dir (<=4096 entries); exact name set; per name lstat regular, nlink==1, ino>0, size==bytes; read_bytes(path, bytes) sha/length; lstat identity unchanged across the read
spec_field_schemas.oracle: {go:{path,sha256}, actual_exit:0 exact int, captures:{stdout,stderr}, verdict_path:{path,sha256}, verdict:'PASS', bound_artifact_digests:{name:sha256}, wait_record:{path,sha256}} (wait_record is an explicit interface extension so 'actual exit0' is parent-observed); oracle GO status=='PARENT_GO', oracle_for==spec.item, differs from main GO; wait record role 'oracle' bound to a role 'oracle' identity; verdict document verdict=='PASS', item==spec.item, bound_artifact_digests typed-equal to spec value which must equal declared artifact digests exactly
spec_field_schemas.identities: nonempty list of exact {role, pid, pgid, start_fingerprint, source}; roles driver|main_child|helper|descendant|unproved|oracle|oracle_child|oracle_helper; exactly one driver (pid/pgid == allocation record); at least one oracle; unique (pid,start_fingerprint). Empty list is invalid because the driver incarnation is always applicable and no contract field can evidence 'none'.
spec_field_schemas.late_audit: {roots:[normalized abs, unique, nonempty], baseline_manifest:{path,sha256}, allowed_new:[abs paths (exact path) or plain names (exact basename)]}; baseline exact {format:'parent-release-late-baseline-v1', roots==spec roots, entries:{abspath:[kind,dev,ino,mode,nlink,size,mtime_ns]}}; fresh walk after part-4 census: NOFOLLOW anchored, no FIFO opened, no cross-device descent, directory fstat stable during scan, <=200000 entries, depth<=64; new/changed/removed entries must each be declared; fstatvfs free bytes (f_bavail*f_frsize) >= 12200000000 per root
spec_field_schemas.reservation: {bytes:int>=0, cpu_slots:int>=0}; typed-equal GO and launch; bytes == registry reservation_bytes; released only by an effective RELEASED

frozen_design.decision_rule: Parts run in order 1..5; each part accumulates every independent cause; a check whose spec input is shape-invalid in another part is skipped and that part reports BLOCKED (the owning part already fired). decision RELEASED iff causes==[] and all five parts PASS; otherwise HELD. Any Exception from a callback becomes the owning field cause with bounded repr evidence. Unexpected module Exceptions become P<k>_INTERNAL_ERROR. No default, waiver or receipt text can produce RELEASED.
frozen_design.disposition_and_ack: One exclusive JSON file per call in commit_dir: name prt-v1-<item slug<=64>-<sha256 of bytes>.json; anchored NOFOLLOW directory walk; os.open O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW mode 0o444; bounded write loop; fsync file; own-fd pread equality; fstat identity; close; fsync directory; ACK = read_bytes(path, exact length) bytes and sha equal AND post-readback lstat under the retained directory fd equals the created dev/ino/size, regular, nlink 1. EEXIST or any failure: no overwrite, no removal, no second disposition; ACK failure => ack ACK_FAILED, returned state HELD, no registry line. Timestamp: only owned_date text (null when owned_date failed; never fabricated). Disposition < 1 MiB: bounded evidence (<=16 strings x 512 chars per cause); spec embedded only when canonical JSON <= 256 KiB, else spec sha256/bytes only; spec > 4 MiB => P1_SPEC_INVALID.
frozen_design.registry: Only after ACK_OK: anchored open of allocation.registry_path O_RDWR|O_APPEND|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK (never O_CREAT); fstat regular nlink 1; pread-verify the part-1 observed prefix (length + sha256), last byte LF, and that every newer suffix line naming this item is a PRT HELD line for this allocation; then one JSON line (sorted keys) {format:'parent-release-registry-v1', item, state RELEASED|HELD, disposition, disposition_sha256, allocation_line_sha256, decision_in_disposition, causes, recorded_at (owned date text or null), reservation, remaining_output_reservation_bytes (0 on RELEASED, bytes on HELD)} + LF; bounded write loop; fsync. Effective returned state RELEASED only if decision RELEASED, ACK_OK, no post-ACK deadline crossing, line fully written and fsync returned. Never rewrites; a write/fsync failure is reported (line_visible flag) and returns HELD.
frozen_design.exceptions: Exception from any callback/module step: recorded cause, evaluation of independent parts continues. BaseException (non-Exception) during evaluation or owned_date: recorded as P<k>_BASE_EXCEPTION, remaining evaluation skipped, ONE bounded HELD commit attempted using only callbacks that have not raised BaseException in this call and without further deadline_check calls (owned_date unsafe => date null; read_bytes unsafe => no ACK => no registry line), then the ORIGINAL BaseException is re-raised. BaseException inside the commit phase: propagates immediately with no further writes; any newer BaseException carries the original as __context__. On-disk effects possible at that point are documented (partial exclusive file; complete-but-unfsynced registry line).
frozen_design.deadline: deadline_check must return None or raise; initial check; after every read_bytes, census and owned_date call; after each scanned directory in the late walk; after decision assembly; after the ACK readback. Non-None return or Exception = crossing: cause P<k>_DEADLINE (P5_DEADLINE_AFTER_ACK after ACK), no further evaluation callbacks, no further deadline_check calls, bounded HELD commit still attempted. A crossing can never be renewed or produce RELEASED.
frozen_design.endedness: census() validated exactly (complete is True, unique pids, exact process keys, observed_at_mono float within the module's time.monotonic() bracket of the call; monotonic values never recorded as timestamps). Causes: identity pid+fingerprint present; identity pid present with another fingerprint (ambiguous); any process whose pgid is an identity pgid; any process whose ppid is an identity pid. Exit codes and receipt text are never used for endedness.
frozen_design.owned_date: exact keys {settled,text,child{pid,pgid,start_fingerprint},reaped,group_empty,stdout_eof,term_sent}; settled/reaped/group_empty/stdout_eof must be True; term_sent exact int 0 (1 => helper overran => HELD); text strict 24-char '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z' validated by datetime construction; called once, after the late audit.
